name: The Ashford Vale
coords: Metres on the X/Z ground plane relative to Ashford at (0, 0); pos = [x, z]. The streamed world is 4 x 4 km (+-2000). Matches WorldGen seed 1066: Kingsreach sits at (560, -420).

places.name: Ashford
places.description: The home village: timber-and-thatch houses around a runestone circle, a mill on the stream, the inn, the smithy and the guard post. Founded by folk who came 'out of the ashes' of an older town.

places.name: Kingsreach
places.description: The royal castle-city of Caldrenn, a morning's ride north-east along the King's Ember Road.

places.name: Emberglass Mere
places.description: A still, deep lake south-west of Ashford. At sunset the water turns the colour of embers. Fishers keep a jetty on the east shore; children are warned off the drop-off in the middle.

places.name: The Ashrun
places.flows: from the northern hills south into Emberglass Mere, out of its south-west shore and away toward the Westfen marshes
places.description: A cold, clear river fed by snowmelt. It turns the Ashford mill by a cut channel and is crossed by the Ashrun Bridge on the Oakvale road.

places.name: Ashrun Bridge
places.description: An old stone bridge where the Oakvale road crosses the Ashrun. Toll-free, but the guard sometimes posts a watch here.

places.name: Duskbriar Wood
places.description: Dense old oak and briar south-east of Ashford, past the edge of the runestone ward. Woodcutters work its northern fringe; wolves and goblins own the rest.

places.name: Tuskridge Hold
places.description: A ring of log longhouses on a hilltop beyond Duskbriar Wood, behind an earthwork and stakes. The exiled Tuskridge clan lives here under an uneasy truce with Ashford.

places.name: Mossfang Warren
places.description: A burrow under the roots at Duskbriar's northern edge: tunnels, snares and a stolen-goods midden. The first real fight most Ashford youths face.

places.name: Shrine of the Sleeping Flame

hidden_trigger.hint: An eight-year-old who climbs to the shrine alone and relights the cold brazier.

places.description: Broken pillars and a cracked brazier on a hilltop west of the Ashrun. Older than Ashford; the carvings show a bird rising from fire. Nobody tends it now.

places.name: Cinderpost Waystation
places.description: A walled halfway post on the King's Ember Road with a stable, a trough, a bunkhouse and a patrol post. Caravans water their oxen here; the notice board carries capital news a day late.

places.name: The King's Ember Road
places.description: The main road from Ashford to the capital, running north-east. Kept safe by patrols and a line of waystones; its surface is packed ash and gravel.

places.name: Whisper Hollow
places.description: A mossy dell on the Ashrun just below the Mere where the wind sounds like voices. Something lives under the old willow.
